title: Internal Unit Economics dashboard dogfood feedback (Round 1) + prioritized fixes for v1.0
creator: Chloe Martin
description:
Goal
Track Round 1 dogfood feedback (Finance/Product/Eng) for the internal Unit Economics dashboard, triage severity, and produce a prioritized fix list required for v1.0 launch readiness.

Context
Dogfood is running on the internal Console page shipped via:
- UI: sources/github/redwood/pr-19378-console-ui-internal-unit-economics-page.json
- API: sources/github/redwood/pr-19374-unit-economics-query-api-endpoints.json
- Data quality checks: sources/github/redwood/pr-19383-add-data-quality-checks-for-economics-pipeline.json

This ticket is the single source of truth for issues discovered during dogfood and what we’re committing to for v1.0 vs pushing to v1.1.

Participants / stakeholders in Round 1
- Finance: Laura Bennett, Rishi Malhotra
- Product: Marissa Cole, Aditya Rao
- Eng: Dylan Brooks, Logan Wright, Nadia Rahman, Mei Lin
- SRE/Obs: Sean Gallagher, Allison Grant
- Design: Alicia Perez

How to give feedback (for anyone joining dogfood late)
1) Include exact filters used (time range, group_by, model/version, region, tier) and screenshot.
2) If the question is “numbers don’t reconcile,” include which totals you’re comparing (billing vs dashboard, QTD vs MTD) and timezone.
3) If it’s a UI issue, include browser + steps.
4) If possible, attach the query_id from the API response header (x-redwood-query-id).

Severity rubric
- S0 (Launch blocker): incorrect blended $/1M output tokens; missing/duplicated hours; tier/region/model mapping wrong in a way that would mislead exec/Finance reporting.
- S1 (High): confusing UX likely to cause misinterpretation; major drilldown failure; query latency makes page unusable.
- S2 (Medium): missing affordance, formatting, annoying bug with workaround.
- S3 (Low): polish.

Summary of Round 1 feedback (as of 2025-02-28)

A) Metric correctness / trust (S0/S1)
1) Finance noticed a day-boundary mismatch when comparing QTD in dashboard vs FP&A sheet.
- Reported by: Rishi
- Symptom: QTD totals differ by ~0.8–1.3% depending on selected time range; difference disappears when using full-hour boundaries.
- Likely cause: dashboard defaults to “Last 7 days” in viewer local timezone; FP&A uses UTC day boundaries with 00:00Z cutoffs.
- Action: Add explicit timezone selector (UTC default) and display aggregation boundary in UI.
- Owner: Console (Nora) + Design (Alicia)
- Tracking: ENG-8451 (created)

2) ‘Unknown region’ bucket increased after region mapping change.
- Reported by: Mei + Sean
- Symptom: 1–2% of tokens showing region=unknown in eu-west time window; drilldown shows affected route ids are gateway streaming paths.
- Notes: There was a null-handling PR (pr-19433-bugfix-region-mapping-null-handling.json) but may not cover older ingestion rows.
- Action: Add a backfill/migration to remap null region codes where mapping exists; keep unknown but add tooltip with count + guidance.
- Owner: Telemetry/Analytics (Mei) with SRE review
- Tracking: ENG-8452 (created)

3) Blended vs marginal cost confusion (not a computation bug, but causes misreads) (S1)
- Reported by: Laura + Marissa
- Symptom: Folks interpret ‘blended $/1M output tokens’ as “per-request billable cost,” especially in Dedicated tier.
- Action: Add “What this metric is / is not” callout on main chart; link to metric dictionary.
- Link: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/unit-economics-dashboard-metrics-and-definitions.json
- Owner: Product + Design
- Tracking: ENG-8453 (created)

4) Dedicated tier tokens appear under Self-serve for a small number of customers (S0)
- Reported by: Dylan (via Eng) after comparing a known Dedicated contract
- Symptom: Customer tier grouping shows self-serve, but contract is Dedicated; discovered via a customer_id check in warehouse.
- Likely cause: Tier derivation relies on billing-plan snapshot; dedicated routing flag not present for older rows; edge case with “pilot credits” overriding plan.
- Action: Fix tier derivation precedence: dedicated/private routing flags must override billing plan; add regression test; backfill last 30d.
- Owner: Telemetry (Logan/Nadia) + Backend (Jada for review)
- Depends on: ENG-8423/PR-19366 + tests PR-19441
- Tracking: ENG-8454 (created)

B) Data coverage / quality indicators (S0/S1)
5) Finance asked for an explicit “data completeness / confidence” indicator on the dashboard.
- Reported by: Laura
- Symptom: When a single hour is missing, the chart looks like a real cost swing; people don’t notice the coverage gap.
- Action: Show a banner when completeness < 99.5% for selected window; include missing hours count and link to runbook.
- Links:
  - SLO: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/unit-economics-pipeline-slo.json
  - Runbook: sources/confluence/eng-platform/how-tos/oncall-guide-unit-economics-dashboard.json
- Owner: SRE/Obs (Allison) + Console (Nora)
- Tracking: ENG-8455 (created)

6) Streaming vs non-streaming toggle requested (S2)
- Reported by: Aditya
- Reason: Optimize team wants to isolate streaming cost behavior when batching changes land.
- Note: In v1 scope, streaming flag exists in telemetry standard, but UI currently doesn’t expose it.
- Action: Decide ship vs defer. Proposed: v1.0 = keep hidden; v1.1 = add as Advanced filter.
- Owner: Product (Marissa)
- Tracking: keep in this ticket; no sub-issue yet.

C) UX / workflow (S1/S2)
7) Filter defaults and saved views for Finance (S1)
- Reported by: Rishi
- Request: One-click “Finance view” (QTD, UTC, blended metric, all tiers) and “Live ops view” (last 24h, local time OK, highlights anomalies).
- Action: v1.0: implement shareable URL w/ full filter state + add “UTC” default. v1.1: saved views.
- Owner: Console (Nora)
- Tracking: included in ENG-8451 for timezone + URL state.

8) Top-N tables: sorting + pagination confusion (S2)
- Reported by: Marissa + Felix
- Symptom: Users don’t realize Top Models is sorted by absolute cost contribution vs $/1M; table header unclear.
- Action: Rename columns, add sort selector: {Cost contribution, $/1M output tokens, Output tokens}. Default: $/1M.
- Owner: Design (Alicia) + Console (Nora)
- Tracking: to be bundled with ENG-8453 (metric explanation + labeling).

D) Performance / reliability (S1)
9) Drilldown query latency spikes for large windows with group_by=model_version (S1)
- Reported by: Sean + Felix
- Symptom: P95 8–12s on 30d window, model_version breakdown; occasional timeouts.
- Likely cause: heavy on-the-fly grouping on non-materialized view.
- Action: short-term: enforce max window for model_version breakdown (e.g., 14d) + show message; medium-term: add/materialize view or use existing optimized views (see pr-19405).
- Owner: Data (Mei) + Backend (Chloe)
- Tracking: ENG-8456 (created)

Prioritized fix list for v1.0 launch (commitment)
P0 (must fix before ENG-8439 go/no-go)
- Tier mapping bug (Dedicated showing as Self-serve) + 30d backfill: ENG-8454
- Timezone/day-boundary clarity (UTC default) + URL shareability for Finance: ENG-8451
- Region unknown backfill for null-mappable regions + tooltip: ENG-8452
- Data completeness banner / confidence indicator linked to SLO/runbook: ENG-8455

P1 (strongly preferred for v1.0 if time allows; otherwise v1.1)
- Metric callout: “blended != billable” + clearer table headers/sorting: ENG-8453
- Drilldown guardrails for expensive groupings (model_version) to prevent timeouts: ENG-8456

P2 (explicit v1.1 candidates)
- Advanced filter: streaming vs non-streaming
- Saved views (Finance / Live ops)
- Export CSV from Top-N tables

Acceptance criteria (for closing ENG-8438)
- All P0 items have owners, linked issues, and either merged PRs or explicit go/no-go decision recorded in ENG-8439.
- Finance (Laura or Rishi) confirms QTD view in dashboard matches agreed boundary rules and reconciliation report behavior (within expected tolerance).
- SRE confirms completeness indicator behavior aligns with SLO thresholds and alert routing.

Update log (condensed)
- 2025-02-18 (Chloe): Created ticket after internal demo; asked Finance/Product/Eng to dogfood with real QTD questions and file findings here.
- 2025-02-20 (Nora): Added repro template; started collecting issues from #finance and #eng-platform Slack threads.
- 2025-02-21 (Rishi): Reported day-boundary mismatch; suggested UTC default to match FP&A cadence.
- 2025-02-24 (Mei): Confirmed region=unknown spike isolated to null region_code rows; proposed mapping backfill.
- 2025-02-25 (Dylan): Found Dedicated misclassified as self-serve for pilot-credit accounts; requested precedence fix + tests.
- 2025-02-26 (Allison): Requested confidence indicator requirements; aligned with SLO doc thresholds.
- 2025-02-28 (Nora): Created sub-issues ENG-8451..ENG-8456 and posted prioritized list in #eng-platform for visibility.

Open questions
- Should UTC be the global default for all internal users, or only for Finance allowlist? Proposal: always default to UTC for this page to reduce ambiguity.
- How to message known limitations of blended metric for Dedicated (idle allocation, overhead) without overloading UI? Proposal: short callout + “Learn more” link.

Sub-issues created (placeholders; to be filled with full details)
- ENG-8451: Add timezone selector (default UTC) + show aggregation boundary + shareable URL state
- ENG-8452: Backfill/remap null region codes where mapping exists; add UI tooltip for unknown
- ENG-8453: Add ‘what this metric is/is not’ callout + clarify Top-N table columns/sorting
- ENG-8454: Fix customer tier derivation precedence + add regression tests + 30d backfill
- ENG-8455: Add completeness/confidence banner (thresholds per SLO) + link to runbook
- ENG-8456: Add guardrails/materialization plan for expensive drilldowns (model_version) to avoid timeouts
